messages:
Jordan: quick check — sprint sync on observability roadmap. Status highlights: dashboards basic cards done, tracing hooks MVP in staging, error-analysis view WIP, retention policy proposal drafted. Any blockers from infra or SRE?

Lia: thanks. can you link the retention proposal? want to confirm 30d/90d buckets for spans/traces. also need to know who will own long-term storage costs.

Jordan: here: https://git.internal/r/redwood/obs/retention-proposal (PR 412). proposal suggests 90d traces (compressed), 30d span indexes, and cold storage for 1y archive. cost estimates in the doc.

Pranav: re ownership — eng-runtime will own the exporters + retention enforcement, eng-platform owns dashboard/ui and rollout. eng-sre owns runtime ops and alerting. We still need legal signoff for archive encryption.

Maya: tracing hooks — frontend middleware PR is at https://git.internal/r/redwood/frontend/PR-89. It wires trace IDs through auth service. Needs a cleanup patch (small rename) and a +1 from Lia for perf review.

Lia: will review today. thinking about adding a sampling knob (0.1 default for high-RPS routes) — can we make it a route-level config?

Jordan: yes, runtime supports route-level sampling. we'll expose in console as 'trace sampling' per route. UX mock in Figma: https://figma.com/file/obs-sampling.

Pranav: dependency note — storage encryption (KMS integration) is blocked by infra ticket INF-721. ETA EOW if infra has capacity. If that slips, archive opt-in has to be postponed.

ops-bot: reminder: oncall handoff at 18:00 UTC. Check the trace retention alert runbook: https://wiki/redwood/trace-retention-runbook

Jordan: error-analysis view — prototype dashboard is live on staging. Screens: per-route error heatmap, stack traces linked to trace IDs, and automated grouping. Need UX feedback and a decision on the grouping threshold (default 5 occurrences).

Maya: grouping threshold sounds fine but want a toggle to switch to time-window grouping (e.g., spikes in last 15m). I'll add that to the UI PR.

Lia: quick code review ping for PRs: frontend/PR-89 (tracing middleware), console/PR-174 (sampling UI), obs/PR-412 (retention). Prioritize PR-89 and PR-412.

Jordan: ack. action items summary:
- Lia: perf review + sampling UX feedback (PR-89 + console/PR-174) — due EOD today
- Pranav/infra: unblock INF-721 or confirm delay — owner: infra team — ETA EOW
- Eng-runtime: finalize exporter retention enforcement config and sampling API — PR target mid-sprint
- Maya: add time-window grouping toggle to error-analysis UI PR
- Eng-sre: validate alert thresholds and runbook (link above)

Pranav: small ask — need 0.5 FTE from eng-sre for two weeks to validate retention load tests. If we don't get it, risk to SLA for ingest spikes.

Lia: we can spare a PM-hour and one SRE for 2 weeks starting next Tuesday. I'll coordinate.

Jordan: perfect. last item — can everyone add themselves to the owners table in the proposal doc with exact contact and oncall rotation? helps for handoffs.

Maya: done — added Maya (frontend), Jordan (proj lead), Pranav (runtime), Lia (perf).

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging -> canary at 2026-03-18T02:30:00Z (jobs queued).

Jordan: wrap-up: no blockers that can't be mitigated, PRs need quick reviews, infra dependency is the main risk. thanks all — will post follow-up notes and updated timeline after INF-721 status update. :thumbsup:
